title: Spain runs a quarter on solar
text: Spain generated more electricity from solar than from coal across a full quarter for the first time, and the grid operator says the record was unremarkable to run.

title: Grid batteries pass 20 GW
text: Global grid-scale battery capacity passed twenty gigawatts, four years earlier than the 2022 central forecast.

title: Heat pumps outsell furnaces again
text: For the third year running, heat pumps outsold gas furnaces in the United States, by a margin that widened in the south.

title: Ridgeline keeps your team’s data where you put it
text: a word from this week’s sponsor.

title: Offshore wind auction clears
text: The delayed North Sea auction cleared at a price below the last onshore round, ending eighteen months of speculation that it would fail.

title: Coal plant closes early
text: A plant scheduled to run until 2031 will close in March, after its owner failed to find a buyer for the last two units.

title: Nuclear restart approved
text: Regulators approved the restart of a reactor idle since 2013, with conditions on cooling water that the operator says it can meet.

title: Transmission line breaks ground
text: Construction started on a line that has been in planning for eleven years, after a rule change removed the last of the county-level vetoes.

title: Solar panel prices fall again
text: Module prices fell another six per cent, which manufacturers describe as unsustainable and installers describe as January.

title: Geothermal drilling doubles
text: Drilling rigs working on geothermal projects doubled year on year, most of them redeployed from oil and gas.

title: Electric buses reach half the fleet
text: One large transit agency now runs more electric buses than diesel, three years ahead of its own plan.

title: Malaria vaccine reaches ten million
text: Ten million children have now received the malaria vaccine, and the programme reports supply rather than demand as the binding constraint.

title: Guinea worm cases fall to nine
text: Nine human cases were recorded worldwide last year, the lowest count since surveillance began.

title: A cheaper insulin arrives
text: A biosimilar insulin launched at a fifth of the reference price, and two large insurers moved it to their preferred tier the same week.

title: Cervical cancer screening changes
text: Self-collected samples were approved for primary screening, which trials suggest reaches women that clinic-based programmes do not.

title: Tuberculosis regimen shortens
text: A four-month regimen matched the six-month standard in a large trial, with fewer people stopping treatment early.

title: Lead in spices traced
text: Investigators traced a cluster of childhood lead poisoning to a single grinding facility, and the recall covers eleven brands.

title: Measles vaccination recovers
text: Routine measles coverage recovered to its pre-2020 level in most countries, though not in the four with the largest outbreaks.

title: Sickle cell therapy approved widely
text: A gene therapy approved in three more countries, with the price still the open question in every one of them.

title: Hospital infections fall
text: Bloodstream infections acquired in hospital fell by a fifth across a national network, which the authors attribute to a checklist rather than to a drug.

title: Snakebite antivenom trial starts
text: The first trial of a synthetic antivenom began in two countries, targeting a group of snakes whose current treatment is horse-derived and scarce.

title: Congestion charge cuts traffic
text: Traffic entering the zone fell by eleven per cent in the first month, and bus speeds rose enough to change the timetable.

title: A city bans right on red
text: Pedestrian injuries at signalised junctions fell in the year after the ban, against a flat trend in neighbouring towns.

title: Housing permits jump
text: Permits rose sharply after a zoning reform that legalised three-storey buildings on lots that previously allowed one.

title: Bike lane network completes
text: The last gap in a protected network closed, and ridership on the connecting segment doubled within six weeks.

title: Bus lanes go camera-enforced
text: Camera enforcement of bus lanes began on four corridors, after a pilot found blocking fell by two thirds.

title: Vacant office converted
text: A conversion of an empty office block to two hundred flats completed under a code written specifically to allow it.

title: Street trees planted at scale
text: Fifty thousand street trees went in over one season, concentrated in the neighbourhoods that measured hottest.

title: Water leaks halve
text: Acoustic sensors across the network cut non-revenue water by half, paying for themselves in under two years.

title: A pedestrian street stays
text: A street pedestrianised as a temporary measure was made permanent, after the shops on it opposed removing it.

title: Night buses return
text: Night service returned to four routes, funded by a levy that the hospitality trade lobbied for.

title: A protein structure puzzle falls
text: A structure that resisted prediction for a decade was solved, and the method generalises to a family of about forty.

title: Room-temperature claim retracted
text: The superconductivity claim was retracted by its authors, who published the raw data alongside the retraction.

title: Ancient genome sequenced
text: A genome recovered from a two-thousand-year-old tooth settles a long argument about a migration route.

title: Fusion shot repeats
text: The ignition result was repeated four times in a row, which is the part that matters and the part that took two years.

title: Coral spawning restored
text: Corals raised in a nursery spawned on a restored reef, the first time the whole cycle has closed outside a tank.

title: Antibiotic found in soil
text: A new class of antibiotic was isolated from a soil bacterium and works against a resistant organism in mice.

title: Telescope sees earliest galaxy
text: The earliest confirmed galaxy is now three hundred million years after the big bang, and it is brighter than models expect.

title: Plastic-eating enzyme improves
text: An engineered enzyme broke down bottle plastic to monomers in hours rather than days, at a temperature a plant could run.

title: Bird flu vaccine for poultry
text: A poultry vaccine cut transmission enough in field trials that two countries changed their culling policy.

title: Quantum error rate falls
text: Logical error rates fell below the physical ones for the first time on a machine of this size.
